rule: No row may be marked PASS from source inspection or host/target build results alone.

tests.description: ESP32-C3 production target firmware boots.
tests.precondition: C3 image flashed to USB bootstrap ota_0.
tests.expected: Boot completes and runtime logs are available.

tests.description: ESP32 Hub production target firmware boots.
tests.precondition: Hub image flashed with its partition table.
tests.expected: Boot completes and runtime logs are available.

tests.description: C3 reports qualified MAC 14:63:93:C5:D1:58.
tests.expected: Observed STA MAC matches the qualified node MAC.

tests.description: Hub reports qualified MAC 5C:01:3B:BE:B9:F8.
tests.expected: Observed STA MAC matches the qualified Hub MAC.

tests.description: ESP-NOW channel is 1 on both targets.
tests.expected: Channel 1 is logged/observed on C3 and Hub.

tests.description: C3 TX power remains API value 40 / 10 dBm.
tests.expected: Configured and observed TX power remains the qualified baseline.

tests.description: AM312 PIR is wired to GPIO4.
tests.expected: GPIO4 changes with PIR output.

tests.description: Onboard LED GPIO8 remains active-low.
tests.expected: LED indication polarity is correct during motion.

tests.description: ota_0/ota_1 state is observable.
tests.expected: Running partition, pending validation, and VALID state can be captured.

tests.description: PIR stabilization completes.
tests.expected: Stabilization completes without a fabricated boot-time event.

tests.description: Motion reaches the existing sensing semantics.
tests.expected: A physical PIR transition is observed by the target adapter.

tests.description: NodeRuntime::record() creates the business event.
tests.expected: Node log proves record() admission.

tests.description: EventKey contains source/session/sequence.
tests.expected: All three identity components are nonzero/valid and logged.

tests.description: NodeMessage is encoded with the bounded codec.
tests.expected: Typed binary frame length and successful encoding are logged.

tests.description: NodeMessage transmits over ESP-NOW.
tests.expected: ESP-NOW send is attempted with the binary data-plane frame.

tests.description: MAC delivery result remains distinct from application ACK.
tests.expected: transport_result() is logged separately; event remains retained until NodeAckMessage.

tests.description: Hub callback queues a bounded frame.
tests.expected: Callback captures metadata/copies/enqueues and returns without business processing.

tests.description: Hub owner task decodes the frame.
tests.expected: Owner-task decode succeeds; callback does not call HubRuntime.

tests.description: HubRuntime accepts the authorized node/session.
tests.precondition: Current session and qualified MAC received.
tests.expected: Authorization/session admission succeeds.

tests.description: Event reaches journal/runtime processing.
tests.expected: run_state_once() processes the event and journal path is observed.

tests.description: Durable application ACK is generated.
tests.expected: AckClass is reflected in make_node_ack().

tests.description: NodeAckMessage returns to the C3.
tests.expected: C3 bounded ACK queue receives and decodes the typed frame.

tests.description: Matching Durable ACK retires only the intended event.
tests.expected: NodeRuntime::acknowledge() retires the matching EventKey only.

tests.description: Application ACK is deliberately dropped where practical.
tests.expected: ACK loss is recorded without deleting the retained event.

tests.description: Event remains retained after dropped ACK.
tests.precondition: MAC success or send attempt without Durable ACK.
tests.expected: Node retains the business event.

tests.description: Retry occurs after ACK loss.
tests.expected: Node sends another attempt.

tests.description: Retry preserves identical EventKey.
tests.expected: source_id, session_id, and sequence are identical.

tests.description: Wrong EventKey ACK does not retire another event.
tests.precondition: A retained event and mismatched ACK are available.
tests.expected: Mismatched ACK is rejected or has no retirement effect.

tests.description: ReceivedVolatile does not retire durable evidence.
tests.precondition: Volatile ACK is delivered for a retained event.
tests.expected: Retained event remains available for Durable ACK.

tests.description: Duplicate packet remains identity-safe under current behavior.
tests.expected: EventKey identity is preserved and current duplicate behavior is recorded.

tests.description: C3 reboot changes NVS boot/session identity.
tests.precondition: Record a session, reboot C3, and record again.
tests.expected: New session differs even if sequence restarts.

tests.description: New session is accepted according to implemented lifecycle.
tests.precondition: Hub observes the new authorized C3 session.
tests.expected: Newer current session is admitted.

tests.description: Stale prior session is rejected.
tests.precondition: Send a frame from the prior session after reboot.
tests.expected: Hub rejects stale-session traffic.

tests.description: Transport RSSI remains visible.
tests.expected: Callback/owner diagnostics include transport RSSI and channel.

tests.description: Transport RSSI does not overwrite semantic RSSI.
tests.precondition: Message has semantic fields and transport metadata.
tests.expected: Diagnostic RSSI remains separate from the portable message contract.

tests.description: FOTA ota_0 -> ota_1 completes.
tests.precondition: Qualified Hub sender and C3 receiver are running.
tests.expected: Image transfers to inactive ota_1 and boots.

tests.description: New ota_1 image is pending validation.
tests.expected: Pending validation is observable before marking valid.

tests.description: ota_1 image is marked VALID.
tests.expected: Image becomes VALID without rollback.

tests.description: PIR is restored after ota_0 -> ota_1.
tests.expected: AM312 operation and GPIO4 path return.

tests.description: Business-message path is restored after ota_0 -> ota_1.
tests.expected: Motion reaches Hub through the runtime data plane.

tests.description: FOTA ota_1 -> ota_0 completes.
tests.expected: Image transfers to inactive ota_0 and boots.

tests.description: New ota_0 image is pending validation.
tests.expected: Pending validation is observable before marking valid.

tests.description: ota_0 image is marked VALID.
tests.expected: Image becomes VALID without rollback.

tests.description: PIR is restored after ota_1 -> ota_0.
tests.expected: AM312 operation and GPIO4 path return.

tests.description: Business-message path is restored after ota_1 -> ota_0.
tests.expected: Motion reaches Hub through the runtime data plane.

tests.description: Durable ACK path works after FOTA.
tests.precondition: Both FOTA directions completed and image is VALID.
tests.expected: Matching Durable ACK retires the correct event.

tests.description: Retry behavior works after FOTA.
tests.precondition: Post-FOTA business event and deliberate ACK loss.
tests.expected: Retry preserves the EventKey and retained evidence.

tests.description: Session identity remains valid after FOTA.
tests.precondition: Post-FOTA C3 boot and first event.
tests.expected: Session identity follows the implemented NVS lifecycle.
